description: This file contains utility functions and classes for processing and grouping recipe ingredients from HTML content, including normalization of fractions, similarity scoring, and ingredient grouping based on HTML structure.

classes.name: IngredientGroup
classes.description: Data class representing a group of ingredients with an optional purpose label.

methods.name: normalize_fractions
methods.description: Converts Unicode fractions in text to ASCII equivalents for consistent matching.

methods.name: score_sentence_similarity
methods.description: Calculates the Dice coefficient to measure similarity between two strings.

methods.name: best_match
methods.description: Finds the most similar string from a list to a given test string, normalizing fractions beforehand.

methods.name: group_ingredients
methods.description: Groups ingredients into categories based on HTML structure and optional selectors, with auto-detection fallback.
